guard.predicate: qrs(i,k,3)==0 AND same process-rate numerator==0 in binary32 at the exact division consumer
guard.action_zero: set only the quotient to zero; retain all other source terms
guard.action_otherwise: execute the original rate/rhox division, including nonzero rate at qg==0

source_anchors.pgmlt: module_mp_kdm6.F:1398-1418 (qg mass and T update precede the rhox volume term)

capture_census.branch_mapping: S10MELTGATE (t>t0c and qg>0) determines stage-1 melt rows; S10PHASE (supcol<0) independently selects stage 2 cold or stage 3 warm ledger rows.

source_hashes.overlay_hash_note: Legacy C overlay hashes predate the stage-1 zero-arm brs store fix. Current overlays were not regenerated because this isolated public worktree does not contain the private canonical Fortran sources.

compile_plan.link_order: shadow KDM6 object before unchanged canonical libwrflib.a

variant_matrix.B_instrumented: compile the generated C overlay with KDM6_PROGB_ZERO_QG_DIV_GUARD undefined; S10 capture/budget events remain enabled
variant_matrix.C_instrumented: compile the same generated C overlay with KDM6_PROGB_ZERO_QG_DIV_GUARD defined; all other source/macros/flags identical

acceptance.within_arm: 253 numeric raw-bit equality + exact Times (254 total variables)
acceptance.guard_replay: Require the fixed 624-key melt/phase gate census, a separately pinned stage-1 key set from B midpoint discovery, and the trusted full event-log SHA-256 from the run receipt; then validate exact-zero S10ZG actions and source-ordered binary32-word S10MASS/S10VOLUME/S10HEAT budgets. Missing external expectations fail closed.
acceptance.between_arm: report B midpoint vs C guard changes separately; no parity requirement
acceptance.nonzero_path_identity: Action-1 keeps the exact original inline rate/rhox source statement; replay checks f32 quotient and source-order budget words. After build, compare matched action-1 site operands/quotients between B and C wherever their input words match.
acceptance.gate_schedule: Require the code-fixed PROGB_CALL_CONTEXTS × {i=113,115} × k=1..39 MELTGATE/PHASE key universe before validating stage-specific ledger keys. Stage-1 keys depend on data and must be frozen from B midpoint discovery before final B/C capture; the source schedule alone does not determine them.
acceptance.trusted_log_commitment: Replay requires a separately recorded capture-run event-log SHA-256 and predeclared stage-1 key set. Neither native commitment exists yet; preliminary discovery evidence cannot be used as final B/C acceptance.
